responsibility: Declares the errno interface for the boot runtime, exporting symbolic errno constants and the helper that retrieves the current host `errno` value. It serves as the Modula-2-facing access point to basic POSIX error codes rather than a full error-management subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Provides the Modula-2-facing errno declarations, including symbolic constants like errno_EINTR/ERANGE/EAGAIN and the errno_geterrno prototype, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gerrno.cc contains the actual accessor implementation.
